verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials is a fair question for a SaaS billing API, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents restricted keys, permission scoping or per-agent credentials. The MCP server and CLI evidence covers different stories (agent connectivity and tooling), not credential scoping, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
